name: tpl-existence-1-goal
task: Pick up the key, then reach the goal.

value.feedback: NO CHANGES NEEDED: Existence(at_goal) hard with Precedence(has_key, at_goal) hard matches 'pick up the key, then reach the goal'. The chain forces has_key, so no separate Existence(has_key) is needed. The door need not be stated, since the environment already forces door_open before at_goal.

texts: Reach the goal (at_goal) at least once, as the last commanded step of the task
Pick up the key (has_key) before reaching the goal (at_goal); the key must be acquired first, and this precedence together with the goal Existence also forces the key to be acquired
